Nick vs. the Brick of Ick from space

name: Nick vs. the Brick of Ick from space
storyline:
The Ick has invaded Earth, and only Nick can stop it!

Command an ever-growing deck of bizarre alien cards as you battle through waves of slimy enemies on your way to confront the monstrous Brick of Ick. Every run offers new cards, new routes, and new strategies, ensuring no two adventures are ever the same.

Precise tactical decisions are just as important as building the perfect deck. Place your cards wisely, combine powerful equipment and slimes and discover ridiculous combinations capable of turning impossible battles into total victories.
summary: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.
